decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 better balances source-relative nucleus count and nearest-neighbor spacing while retaining the same approved tissue geometry.
Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 has a higher local-population score and a more source-like count and nearest-neighbor distribution.
All candidates pass the frozen gates. Candidate 03 provides the best overall balance of source-like nuclear scale, count and nearest-neighbor spacing with the highest local-population score.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 83,884-pixel joint change is a coherent significant expansion along the authorized tumor-stroma boundary; the 77,612-pixel tissue component remains coupled to native tumor and preserves surrounding non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 102 placed nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.985, 1.182, 0.976 and 1.028, with local sampling score 0.906.
decisions.coupling: Added nuclei remain within the authorized expanded tumor footprint; seam, compatibility, quota, spatial-distribution and density checks pass.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited tissue and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: Nucleus count is moderately above the source reference but remains within the frozen envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff.
